preflight.verification: Readable actual local PNG, inspected via view_image; imagegen schema accepts absolute local image files as editing inputs. Pass this path directly. Separate service ingestion receipt not exposed.

scope: C-B only: all three necks reach forward together, no promotion/reordering for visual emphasis; lower/rightmost head R stays frontmost. Same airborne stride.

mask.coordinate_system: Canonical 552x522, top-left origin. Polygon rasterized with pinned sprites-post preparation.region.
mask.reason: Tool accepts image references but has no mask field; apply mask deterministically after generation using sprites-post raster.apply. All RGBA bytes outside mask must remain identical to 008.

prompt.serialization: Terminal LF in text file; exact tool arguments logged separately.

stop_rule: No image-free fallback. If reference transmission fails, stop. Reject candidate if head order/neck assignment changes.

versioning.scheme: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH for the capture asset work package
versioning.MAJOR: New action family or incompatible identity/anatomical/coordinate contract. Does not authorize redesign.
versioning.MINOR: Compatible addition of a new pose/capability to the package.
versioning.PATCH: Correction/retake of the same existing pose without changing the canonical identity or action.
versioning.this_change: 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1: corrected C-B, newly requested all-head reach; no new action/pose ID.
versioning.separate_namespaces: Prompt ID 002 is immutable attempt sequence; protocol 16.0.0 and external tool versions remain unchanged. Date YYYYMMDD in filename and ISO-8601 updated_at with Europe/Rome offset in metadata.
